purpose: Bounded independent original capability probes plus a source-reviewed browser inventory. Probe success covers the tested sample only, not an entire standard.

probes.label: Async function syntax and Promise result
Mapped arguments and strict arguments
probes.source: function f(a){arguments[0]=3;return a;}function g(a){"use strict";arguments[0]=3;return a;}test.record(f(1));test.record(g(1));

probes.label: bind name, length and prototype ownership
Bound ordinary construction and instanceof
probes.source: function Box(a,b){this.total=a+b;}let Bound=Box.bind({ignored:true},3);let value=new Bound(4);test.record(value.total);test.record(value instanceof Box);test.record(value instanceof Bound);

probes.label: Own descriptor reflection does not invoke getter
Own names include nonenumerable keys and omit symbols
Own descriptors preserve getters and symbol keys
Entries enumerate own enumerable strings in order
Assign invokes getter and copies symbols
String wrapper construction
probes.note: Primitive string properties work separately; wrapper objects remain a distinct capability.

probes.label: Explicit Symbol.dispose method call
probes.note: No using syntax or automatic resource-disposal protocol is provided.

probes.label: Native iterable protocol
probes.note: Symbol.iterator is not advertised until native iterator protocol support exists; page-defined polyfills remain possible.

probes.label: for-of array values
probes.note: This small test does not establish user-defined iterator semantics.

probes.label: UTF-16 length and valid surrogate pairs
String replace callback receiver and arguments
Global regexp replacement callbacks and captures
Lookbehind
probes.note: One original lookbehind sample; named captures and full regexp conformance are separate.

probes.label: Promise resolution object
probes.note: Does not test scheduling or microtask ordering.

probes.label: URL constructor
probes.note: Constructs a local URL value; performs no network request.

probes.label: Map entries iterator
probes.note: Collection-specific entries()/next() works independently of the unadvertised Symbol.iterator protocol.

probes.label: Typed array numeric conversion and shared views
Bounded recursive calls
probes.note: The implementation deliberately caps nested calls at32; this test exceeds that policy while Node completes.

probes.label: Explicit unpaired-surrogate rejection
probes.note: Language strings use UTF-8; unmatched UTF-16 surrogates remain explicitly unsupported.

probes.label: Replacement callbacks receive undefined captures and UTF-16 offsets
Global matches are collected before callbacks and result dollars are literal

browser_inventory.scope: Original Rust standard-library implementation; no third-party Cargo dependencies or embedded browser/JS engine.
browser_inventory.limits: Targeted checks do not constitute an independent security audit.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Original bounded tokenization/tree building, entities, raw script/style text and textarea RCDATA.
browser_inventory.limits: 20,000 nodes and128 open elements; no claim of complete HTML parsing conformance.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Selectors, node lists/live tag collections, supported element/text creation, attributes and bounded tree mutation.
browser_inventory.limits: 256 added nodes, depth128 and1MiB retained growth; innerHTML, Shadow DOM and full DOM coverage unavailable.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Native controls including textarea, GET/URL-encoded POST, validation, submit events and queued form.submit().
browser_inventory.limits: No requestSubmit/full form model; script submissions same-origin HTTP(S), CSP form-action enforced.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Supported native input/lifecycle/resource events, capture/bubble listeners, once/passive options and bounded custom-name registration.
browser_inventory.limits: 64 listeners; custom registration is inert without a native event source; no general dispatchEvent interface.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Function timers and requestAnimationFrame driven by the native App queue.
browser_inventory.limits: 64 pending timers,4096 timer callbacks per document,64 pending frames; no Promise microtask queue.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Links, address navigation, Back/Forward, reload, bounded script Location writes and POST resubmission protections.
browser_inventory.limits: Script navigation remains same-origin with rate/count limits; not the Navigation API.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Original HTTP/1.1, redirects, framing, per-load connection reuse, gzip/zlib deflate and cancellation.
browser_inventory.limits: No HTTP/2 or HTTP/3; five redirects,3 connections/load and bounded body/header/metadata sizes.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Authenticated TLS1.2/1.3 subset, explicit trust roots, hostname/signature/Finished verification and one bounded TLS1.3 retry.
browser_inventory.limits: Restricted suites/key types/chains; revocation/CT/full TLS ecosystem support not claimed.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: CSP and request blocking apply to supported loads; cross-origin HTTPS classic scripts have an explicit credential-free policy.
browser_inventory.limits: Other automatic resources retain origin restrictions; full CSP/CORS/Fetch conformance is not claimed.
browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: No fetch, XMLHttpRequest or WebSocket implementation.

browser_inventory.verification: Source review only in this inventory; separate project Rust/integration results are not rerun or counted by this tool.

browser_inventory.scope: Memory-only session cookies, exact-host policy and HttpOnly exclusion from document.cookie.
